title: Мастер-класс и билеты на Кипр  (The Masterclass and Tickets to Cyprus)

scenes.title: Tickets to Cyprus and Barani's Visit
scenes.summary: Max boasts that his life with Sasha is going great until she surprises him with two trip vouchers to Cyprus, while Chef Barinov furiously rejects hosting a masterclass for celebrity chef Valdemar Barani.

scenes.title: Searching for the Travel Passport
scenes.summary: Vika and Kristina insist that Claude Monet needs the PR from Barani's two-day visit to Russia, while Max frantically searches his apartment with Kostya for his foreign passport.

scenes.title: The Passport Left at Vika's Place
scenes.summary: Max realizes he left his travel passport at Vika's apartment before their breakup and tries calling the restaurant to find out when she will be away from home.

scenes.title: Meeting Valdemar Barani
scenes.summary: Kristina welcomes famous culinary author Valdemar Barani into the Claude Monet kitchen and introduces him to the cooks and Chef Viktor Petrovich Barinov.

scenes.title: Old Acquaintances and Igor's Visit
scenes.summary: Barani warmly greets Viktor Petrovich as his first teacher while the Chef seethes, and outside Vika's apartment persistent admirer Igor confronts Vika for ignoring his messages.

scenes.title: The Truth About Paris and Hiding in the Closet
scenes.summary: Vika rejects Igor's advances while Max hides inside her apartment, and back at the restaurant Chef Barinov bitterly tells the cooks how his former sous-chef Volodya Baranov betrayed him in Paris.

scenes.title: The Fight at Vika's and Broken Equipment
scenes.summary: Max bursts out and accuses Vika of sleeping with Igor, while at the restaurant Chef Barinov and Nagiyev drunkenly apologize after smashing Barani's expensive cooking equipment.

scenes.title: Tangled Feelings
scenes.summary: Max and Vika argue intensely in her apartment over their breakup before giving in to a passionate kiss when she challenges him to stay.

scenes.title: The Cooks' Revenge for the Chef
scenes.summary: Kristina scolds the staff for the damaged equipment, and after Barani leaves for the night, Senya and Fedya offer to vandalize his luxury car to avenge Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: The Morning After the Reconciliation
scenes.summary: Max wakes up with Vika hoping she has forgiven him and suggests flying away together, but Vika insists that giving in to emotion does not erase his infidelity.

scenes.title: The Chef Becomes a Sous-Chef
scenes.summary: Valdemar Barani begins his public masterclass in the dining room and publicly humiliates Viktor Petrovich by inviting him up as his assistant.

scenes.title: Max's Doubts
scenes.summary: The cooks watch Barani boss Barinov around during the masterclass, while Max confides in Kostya that he wants to break up with Sasha and win Vika back.

scenes.title: The Swimsuit for Cyprus
scenes.summary: Max tries to break up with Sasha before their trip, but she pulls him into a fitting room to model her new bikini for Cyprus and melts his resolve.

scenes.title: Vinegar in the Signature Roll
scenes.summary: While assisting Barani with his signature meat roll, Chef Barinov secretly pours a bottle of vinegar into the dish before putting it into the oven, while Senya and Fedya sabotage Barani's car outside.

scenes.title: Louis's Panic and Sasha's News
scenes.summary: Louis panics that the police will arrest the cooks for messing with Barani's car, and Sasha cheerfully informs Vika that she and Max are flying to Cyprus for the weekend.

scenes.title: Valdemar's Confession
scenes.summary: While waiting for his roll to bake, Valdemar Barani tells the kitchen staff his side of the Paris story and admits he once worshipped Viktor Petrovich like a culinary god.

scenes.title: Regrets and the Finished Roll
scenes.summary: Barani admits he was forced to tell the Paris restaurant owner the truth that got Barinov fired, and Lyova announces that the signature meat roll is ready to serve.

scenes.title: The Pupil's Toast and the Vinegar Taste
scenes.summary: Before the guests taste the roll, Barani publicly credits Viktor Petrovich Barinov as the true creator of the dish and gifts him a brand-new car, right as the vinegar ruins the tasting.

scenes.title: Two Invitations for the Evening
scenes.summary: Sasha calls Max to say her suitcase is packed for Cyprus just before Vika calls to invite him over to talk, while Chef Barinov wrestles with guilt over Barani's generosity.

scenes.title: The Ruined Convertible and Max's Choice
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov discovers that Senya and Fedya poured rancid sauce into the new convertible Barani just gifted him, and Max arrives at Sasha's door without his luggage to tell her the truth.
